name: veterinary_clinic_system_064_microchip_format_audit
instruction: Audit microchip registrations against ISO 11784 (15 numeric digits — verify online if unsure). For every patient whose microchip_id is missing, null, or not exactly 15 digits, set microchip_flag='non_compliant' and microchip_flagged='<batch_code>'. Compliant patients stay byte-identical; do not invent new chip numbers.

success_criteria.summary: From snapshot: patients failing regex ^\d{15}$ -> flagged with nonce; others byte-identical; count 30.

checks.expect: From snapshot: patients failing regex ^\d{15}$ -> flagged with nonce; others byte-identical; count 30.

domain_searches.query: ISO 11784 pet microchip 15 digit format country code 985 manufacturer
top_results: Manufacturer's ISO Codes (Alberta Animal Health Source PDF)
Microchipping - The Importance of ISO (WSAVA PDF)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Format validation from an external standard; flag-without-inventing is the discipline under test.
